_meta.describes: Inputs to the native slot allocator, plus the default allocation.
notes: The allocator blends each discipline's share of token potential (weight `blend`) with its share of eligible badges (weight 1-blend), scales by `total_slots`, clamps to per-discipline minimums/maximums, then distributes any rounding remainder using the tie-break orders.
Every build gets 20 slots across the six disciplines.
